items.title: Joseph Ralph Robinson Interview, 1960-10-12
items.q: And so, so I used to call my boy, Bud Scott. We play all in LaVonia, only for white folks, you know.

ctx.x: I see. He wasn't playing in the city steady. No, no, no, no.

And you were up in the country too? Yeah, I was in the country, you know. Yeah. In a place they call, uh, Chanel. Yeah. Chanel from New Road, about 20, 20 some odd mile, coming from New Road. They call it, uh, up, coming this way, you know. Yeah. Yeah. And so, so I used to call my boy, Bud Scott. We play all in LaVonia, only for white folks, you know. We play for concerts, such as, uh, concerts and dances and everything. We had a little rig, you know, with two horses. Oh, is it? Yeah. We used to go out there,…
You got the whole band, didn't they?
